hook.name: JoltHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Jolt token launchpad that collects protocol and creator fees on swaps via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta. Includes an anti-snipe mechanism that charges elevated fees for early buys within a configurable number of blocks after token launch, with fees routed to token creators and claimable on-demand.
